title: Package registry outage
summary: Simulate the primary package registry being unavailable to a clean build.

trigger.description: New workers cannot download packages from the primary registry.

assumptions: A lockfile alone does not prove that package bytes are retained.
Fallback sources require an explicit review.

inputs.name: fallback_source
inputs.description: Reviewed mirror or cache policy for clean builds.

score.formula: 100 minus bounded penalties for dependency sources without a tested fallback

recovery_actions: Verify a clean build against a reviewed mirror.
Record retention and expiry checks for cached package bytes.
limitations: Does not contact a package registry.
Does not verify package integrity beyond repository metadata.
